narr: Scattered showers and thunderstorms developed in the afternoon hours on October 6th and lasted well into the evening hours. Multiple reports of damaging winds, flash flooding, some hail, and even a tornado were received.
ev: Cane Creek Road and Highway 30 near Fall Creek Falls State Park are impassable in some places due to flooding.

Several reports of flash flooding and roads closed throughout eastern Van Buren County, including Park Road near the Rockhouse, and Highway 30E between Van Buren County Head Start and Cane Creek Road.
Part of Franklin Loop washed away by flood waters.
Culvert on Bear Creek Road was washed out.
Several roads were flooded and damaged across Cumberland County including East Cove Road, Cow Pen Road, Bud Tanner Road, Wolf Creek Road, Lowe Road, and Claysville Lane.
Rickman Road and Hanging Limb Highway were flooded and impassable. Several private drives also flooded.
Video showed flooding on Pumpkin Creek Road with water surrounding and entering some buildings.
Several roads are flooded south of Waverly, including Pumpkin Creek Road, Forks of the River Road, and Span Loop.
Water was flowing over Highway 70 in Waverly.
Madison Street near First Bank, and Lane Parkway near Police HQ, were flooded and impassable.
Reports of several flooded roads in the Flatwoods area.
A car with 2 occupants was swept off Mooneyham Lonewood Road. The passenger, a 67 year old male, died and the female driver was injured.
